acceptance_predicates.description: An active leased task with an empty branch and a matching valid predeclared worktree key can bind its missing branch without replacing the key.
Mismatched keys, branch-only partial metadata, invalid identities, stale revisions, expired or foreign owners, and active identity collisions reject without mutation.
Git and SQLite tests cover the transition and the bounded lifecycle model explores matching and mismatched key requests.

definition_of_done: The Coordinator source change is merged to main with locally reproducible functional verification.
Focused and complete test, quality, and bounded-model evidence are recorded for the exact implementation head.
No external signature, authentication, hosted approval, or independent reviewer is required for acceptance or release.

inputs.description: A claimed Coordinator task with an empty branch and a valid predeclared worktree key.

outputs.description: A fenced Coordinator transition that completes only a matching partial legacy identity.

gates.description: Locally reproducible tests, quality checks, and bounded-model evidence cover the exact implementation head.
